excerpt: MediaTek’s new flagship SoC, the Dimensity 9000, is a key milestone, being the first Total Compute solution available on silicon. The premium Total Compute solution adopts the powerful Arm Cortex-X2 CPU alongside 3x Arm Cortex-A710 CPUs and 4x Arm Cortex-A510 CPUs
notes: Arm's own newsroom post (author Arm SVP) from Nov 2021, older than the 2023+ preference; shows MediaTek SoC adopting Arm Cortex CPU IP.
